question: vendor trips struct list by hour and passenger
sql:
WITH vendor_structs AS (
  SELECT VendorID,
         LIST_AGG(STRUCT(pickup_hour := EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime), passenger := passenger_count) ORDER BY tpep_pickup_datetime) AS trips
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  GROUP BY VendorID
)
SELECT VendorID,
       s.pickup_hour,
       s.passenger
FROM vendor_structs,
     UNNEST(trips) AS s(pickup_hour, passenger);

hourly avg speed struct list sorted desc
sql:
WITH speeds AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour,
         (trip_distance) / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tpep_dropoff_datetime - tpep_pickup_datetime)) / 3600.0) AS speed
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  WHERE tpep_dropoff_datetime > tpep_pickup_datetime
),
hourly AS (
  SELECT hour, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
  FROM speeds
  GROUP BY hour
)
SELECT LIST_AGG(STRUCT(hour := hour, avg_speed := avg_speed) ORDER BY avg_speed DESC) AS hourly_speed_structs
FROM hourly;

question: top5 dropoff zones tip totals struct list
sql:
WITH tip_agg AS (
  SELECT DOLocationID AS zone,
         SUM(tip_amount) AS tip_total,
         COUNT(*) AS trips
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  GROUP BY DOLocationID
)
SELECT (LIST_AGG(STRUCT(zone := zone, tip_total := tip_total, trips := trips) ORDER BY tip_total DESC))[:5] AS top_zones
FROM tip_agg;

question: vendor distinct passenger counts unnest list
sql:
WITH vendor_pass AS (
  SELECT VendorID,
         LIST(DISTINCT passenger_count) AS passenger_list
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  GROUP BY VendorID
)
SELECT VendorID, pc AS passenger_count
FROM vendor_pass,
     UNNEST(passenger_list) AS pc
ORDER BY VendorID, pc;
